ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.

16. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for plants environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Managing waste environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Light environment School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
